question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget ship as a sessions.list-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for the broader sessions.activity.* Gateway contract?
rationale: The UI request is coherent, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing choice that cleanup automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the open dashboard ops-widget PR as the implementation candidate, while requiring its proof, refresh, dependency, and security blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader sessions.activity.* API defines current task, progress, attention, and child-rollup semantics, then implement the widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold sequencing into the roadmap
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own roadmap ordering while preserving this issue as the concrete acceptance target for the agent-status widget.

recommendation.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the open dashboard ops-widget PR as the implementation candidate, while requiring its proof, refresh, dependency, and security blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main Control UI/session-surface routing signal and this choice crosses product and API boundaries.
